scope: The historical Chief Factor’s House at Fort Témiscamingue, including the main dwelling, its gabled back wing and a central covered link.
era: Late Hudson’s Bay Company trading post, represented in 1888.

stories.title: Fort Temiscamingue: Where the Cedars Dance at the Narrows

originalReview.notes: The exact 1876 McLaughlin Qualla original establishes the shoreline group’s period appearance. Roy’s work identifies the central passage and rear wing. The house ruin outline supplies an approximate scale and alignment. Individual roof details, openings and veranda are interpreted.

review.method: Exact Qualla historical photo, geospatial ruin and written archaeological facts
